agent.finish_summary: Fixed BarrelList regression in boltons/listutils.py: (1) pop(index) had inverted empty/non-empty branch logic causing deletion of live data from non-empty sublists (the root cause of the length-mismatch and getitem/sort failures); corrected so sublists are only removed when actually empty. (2) extend()/append() never called _balance_list, so BarrelList never split into multiple sublists as its own docstring requires; restored the _balance_list(-1) call in both, matching the pattern used by insert/setitem/sort. Verified via stress testing against a reference list (random indexed pops, sort, getitem past end) and doctest execution; all behavioral checks pass.
